A group buy is when a song file is bought by the community, via the community members contributing individual amounts of money via discord, until the full price is reached in sort of a fundraiser. Once the goal is reached, the song file is leaked to the public. Usually made through temporary Discord Servers.
A yedit is a fan made audio edit, remix or conceptual reconstruction of an unreleased or released song by ye usually posted to .gg/yedits or r/yedits.
A Comp is a compilation of several yedits put together to make an album.
A playlist is a group of yedits and/or leaks put together in an attempt to make a cohesive album.
